<!DOCTYPE html>
            <html>
            <meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8">
            <link href="/jscore/images/icons/favicon.ico" rel="shortcut icon">
            <title> </title>
        <style type="text/css">
/* @ProductionAllowed */

@font-face {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans';
    font-weight: 400;
    font-style: normal;
    src: url(data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('woff');
}

@font-face {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans';
    font-weight: 500 700;
    font-style: normal;
    src: url(data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('woff');
}

@font-feature-values 'IBM Plex Sans' {
    @styleset {
      ibm-plex-sans-alternate-g: 2;
    }
}

@font-face { /* light normal */
    font-family: 'Open Sans';
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: normal;
    src: url(data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('woff');
}

@font-face { /* light italic */
    font-family: 'Open Sans';
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
    src: url(data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('woff');
}

@font-face { /* regular normal */
    font-family: 'Open Sans';
    font-weight: 400;
    font-style: normal;
    src: url(data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('woff');
}

@font-face { /* regular italic */
    font-family: 'Open Sans';
    font-weight: 400;
    font-style: italic;
    src: url(data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('woff');
}

@font-face { /* semibold */
    font-family: 'Open Sans';
    font-weight: 700;
    font-style: normal;
    src: url(data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('woff');
}

@font-face { /* semibold italic */
    font-family: 'Open Sans';
    font-weight: 700;
    font-style: italic;
    src: url(data:application/font-woff;charset=utf-8;base64,) format('woff');
}

@font-face { /* Regular Italic */
    font-family: 'Open Sans Extended';
    src: url('/fonts/extended/opensans-italic-webfont.woff') format('woff');
    font-weight: 400;
    font-style: italic;
}

@font-face { /* Light */
    font-family: 'Open Sans Extended';
    src: url('/fonts/extended/opensans-light-webfont.woff') format('woff');
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: normal;
}

@font-face { /* Light Italic */
    font-family: 'Open Sans Extended';
    src: url('/fonts/extended/opensans-lightitalic-webfont.woff') format('woff');
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
}

@font-face { /* Regular */
    font-family: 'Open Sans Extended';
    src: url('/fonts/extended/opensans-regular-webfont.woff') format('woff');
    font-weight: 400;
    font-style: normal;
}

@font-face { /* Semibold */
    font-family: 'Open Sans Extended';
    src: url('/fonts/extended/opensans-semibold-webfont.woff') format('woff');
    font-weight: 700;
    font-style: normal;
}

@font-face { /* Semibold Italic */
    font-family: 'Open Sans Extended';
    src: url('/fonts/extended/opensans-semibolditalic-webfont.woff') format('woff');
    font-weight: 700;
    font-style: italic;
}

@font-face {
    font-family: 'Noto Color Emoji';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-display: swap;
    src: url('/fonts/NotoColorEmoji.0.woff2') format('woff2');
    unicode-range: U+1f1e6-1f1ff;
}

@font-face {
    font-family: 'Noto Color Emoji';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-display: swap;
    src: url('/fonts/NotoColorEmoji.1.woff2') format('woff2');
    unicode-range: U+200d, U+2620, U+26a7, U+fe0f, U+1f308, U+1f38c, U+1f3c1, U+1f3f3-1f3f4, U+1f6a9, U+e0062-e0063, U+e0065, U+e0067, U+e006c, U+e006e, U+e0073-e0074, U+e0077, U+e007f;
}

body {
     background-color: #e8e8e8;
     text-align: center;
     font-family: "Open Sans", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}

.errorImage {
    margin-top:40px;
}

.title {
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    width: 550px;
    margin-top: 65px;
    font-size: 25px;
    color: #227fff;
    line-height: 30px;
}

.description {
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    width:500px;
    margin-top:25px;
    font-size:14px;
    color:#4b4b4b;
    line-height:20px;
}
        </style>
            <body>
                <img src="/jscore/images/http/old.png" class="errorImage" alt="">
                <div class="title">Oops, it looks like your browser is out of date!</div>
                <div class="description">Avature no longer supports this browser version due to its security vulnerabilities. To continue enjoying Avature, please upgrade to a supported version of this browser or switch to the latest version of another browser.</div>
            </body>
        </html>
